verdict.rationale: GitHub docs claim broad agentic coding abilities (debugging, complex rebases/merge conflict handling, codebase editing, PR review) that would cover tests/lint/dependencies/conflict resolution, but multiple hands-on community reports describe it getting stuck in loops, failing basic file edit/read operations, ignoring GEMINI.md config, and being 'terrible at agentic stuff', directly undercutting the vendor claims for this exact use-case.
